messages:
ara-dev: Quick q before onboarding call with Acme in 30 — where do I look for their Prom targets + Grafana dashboards for the VPC deployment? They said logs go via promtail -> OTLP collector (private). Also need to check alert thresholds they want tuned.

jess-sre: For VPC customers we store pointers in the onboarding ticket (Zendesk) + a shortlink in customer-obs-metadata. Try: https://onboard.internal/acme/obs or search ticket #ACME-422. Also Grafana lives at https://grafana-private.redwood/acme (service account token required). :mag:

sam-platform: If you have access, you can list Prom targets with:

`````
curl -k -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://priv-prom-acme.redwood.internal/api/v1/targets
`````

That returns scrape targets and labels. For promtail/otlp verify the collector endpoint in the customer's config map: `observability.collector.otlp.endpoint` — usually `https://otlp-collector.acme:4318/v1/logs`.

mike-observability: If alerts are firing too much, check the alertmanager group's `for:` duration and the `severity` label on the alert rules in `/etc/prometheus/rules/customer-acme.rules.yml`. Increasing `for: 5m` -> `10m` helped another customer. Also add `route: receiver: acme-oncall` in Alertmanager if needed.

ara-dev: Thanks — I don't have the token. Who should I ask for access? Also how do I view Grafana via SSO from our side? I don't want to ask the customer for more creds.

jess-sre: Ping @sam-platform to add your team to the `acme-obs-read` group. Grafana SSO is via our Okta proxy — we can grant a service-account link. If you need an ad-hoc link use the "View as read-only" URL in the onboarding ticket (expires 24h): https://links.redwood/view/ACME-obs.

deploy-bot: Deployment complete: prom-priv-proxy v2.3.1 rolled to acme namespace at 2025-03-13T14:12:07Z :rocket:

sam-platform: Quick sanity check before the call: can you paste the last 3 lines from the promtail logs? e.g.

`````
kubectl -n acme logs -l app=promtail --tail=3
`````

That'll confirm if log forwarder is healthy (look for "pushed logs to OTLP" / "error connecting").

ara-dev: pasted output in ticket: "pushed logs to OTLP endpoint, batch=48" — looks good. I'll grab the prometheus targets and share dashboard links in the call. Thanks all :thumbsup:
